vya_text: dI0 - adhunAvalehAnAM prathamatastatsvarUpaviShayaM darSayannAha - kvAthAdInAmiti | kvAthAdInAmityAdi grahaNAt svarasaPANTakalkAdayo~aBidhIyante Ganatvamiti | sAndratvaM yAvadBavati tAvatpAkaH kartavya iti BAvaH | pAkastu kvAthAdInAM Bavati, yataH prathamataH kvAthavidhinA pAkaM kRutvA paScAt pAkena lehaH syAditi | tanmAtreti tasyA~avalehaBakShaNArthaM mAnaM palamitaM boddhavyaM, iti sAmAnyamAnaM BakShaNe~aBihitam || 1 ||

pada: aShTamo~adhyAyaH | kvAthAdInAM punaH pAkAdGanatvaM sA rasakriyA | so~avalehaSca lehaH syAttanmAtrA syAtpalonmitA ||1 ||

vya_text: dI0 - idAnImanukte sitAdInAM parimANamAha -- anuktamAnAvalehe sitA caturguNA deyA | caturguNatA~atra sakaladravyAdityarthaH | guDastu dviguNa iti cUrNadravyAt | dravaM toyakShIrAdikaM caturguNam | atrApi cUrNAditi BAvaH | sarvatra niScaya iti svatantre paratantre vA || 2 ||

pada: sitA caturguNA kAryA cUrNAcca dviguNo guDaH | dravaM caturguNaM dadyAditi sarvatra niScaya || 2 ||

vya_text: dI0 - supakva iti | samyak pakve~avalehe etAdRuSaM lakShaNaM Bavati, kIdRuSaM tadAha - tantumattvamityAdi | darvyA sa~jcAlanena tantusaMyukta iva dRuSyate, tena mRudyamAno~a~gguligrAhI BavatItyarthaH | apsu majjatIti pAnIyamadhye yadA kShiptastadA nimagno Bavati | sthiratvamiti niScalatvam etena dravarahita ityarthaH | tathAhi - ``toyapUrNe yadA pAtre kShipto na plavate guDaH | kShiptastu niScalastiShThet patitastu na SIryate || eSha pAko guDAdInAM sarveShAM parikIrtitaH'' iti | pIDite mudreti tasminna~ggulyAdipIDite sati mudrAdInAmudBavo Bavati, mudrA~atra nimnatA | yaduktaM ``pIDite tu yadA~ggulyA nimnatA tatra jAyate'' iti | gandhavarNarasodBava iti sugandhopetaH surasopeta iti | yo~avaleho Bavati sa supakva ityarthaH || 3 ||

gU0 - kvAthAdeH kaShAyAderyatpunaH pakvAt sA rasakriyA ucyate avaleho lehaSca ucyate nAmataH tanmAtrA palonmitA syAt | cUrNAt sitA caturguNA, guDo dviguNaH, evaM caturguNamiti niScayaH | avalehe supakve tantumattvaM syAt, sparSena pIDite svarasatve mudrA ca Bavati | gandhavarNarasodBavastadA siddhaM Bavet || 3 ||

pada: athAvalehasya siddhilakShaNamAha - supakve tantumattvaM syAdavaleho~apsu majjati | KaratvaM pIDite mudrAgandhavarNarasodBavaH || 3 ||

vya_text: dI0 - dugdhamiti | dugdhamiti sAmAnyagrahaNena sarvANi kShIrANi yathAdoShaM grAhyANi | ikShurasagrahaNena sarve ikShuvikArA gRuhyante | pa~jcamUlI mahatI hrasvA vA yathA vyAdhivihitA grAhyA | kaShAyajamiti yUShamityarthaH | tena pa~jcamUlasya kaShAyeNa kRutvA yUShaH so~anupAnamiti BAvaH | kaShAyagrahaNena svarasakvAthakalkAdayo grAhyAH | vAsAkvAtha iti | vAsA ATarUShakaH, yathAyogyamiti yad yasya doShasya yogyaM tadyathAyogyam | etena doShAnurUpamiti vyAdhyanusAraM kathitaH, tadyathA - vAte~amlamadhuralavaNaprAyAH snigdhAdayaH, pitte madhurakaShAyatiktaprAyAH SItAdayaH, kaPe tiktoShaNakaShAyaprAyA rUkShAdayaH | mAtrA yathA tathAhyuktam - ``anupAnaM prayoktavyaM kaPavyAdhau palaM Bavet | paladvayaM tu pitte vAnilaje ca palatrayam'' iti | yadvA ``gaNDUShaM mAtrayA deyaM mRudau krUre tu pa~jca ca | anupAnaM prayoktavyaM deSakAlAdyapekShayA'' iti | anupAnamiti | anu paScAtpAnaM tat kutaH tadAha - ``yathA jalagataM tailaM tatkShaNAdeva sarpati | tathA BaiShajyama~ggeShu prasarpatyanupAnataH'' iti || 4 ||

pada: idAnImanukteShvanupAnamAha - dugdhamikShuraso yUShaH pa~jcamUlIkaShAyajam | vAsAkAtho yathAyogyamanupAnaM praSasyate || 4 ||

vya_text: dI0 - sa yatheti taM darSayannAha - kaNTakArIti | laGukaNTakArikA sA samUlaPalaSAKA grAhyA | nIradroNa iti caturADhakaparimite pAnIye tryUShaNaM pratyekaM palapramANamAhuH | dhanvayAsakaH durAlaBA rAsnA, suraBI, SarkarA palaviMSatiriti sugamam | GRutatailayoriti militvA ShoDaSapalAni | GRutamatra goGRutam AjaM vA vyAdhivihitatvAt tailaM kaTutailamatra vadantyeke | yataH ``kAse SvAse ca hikvAyAM kaTutailaM prayojayet'' iti | kvacidasya prayogo~api dRuSyate ``guDaM kaTukatailena miSrayitvA samaM lihet | trisaptAhaprayogeNa SvAsaM nirmUlato jayet'' iti | SIte madhupalAShTakamiti| madhukShaudramaShTapalapramANaM SIte himasparSe vinikShipedityarthaH | yataH `uShNArtamuShNairuShNe ca tannihanti yathAviSham' iti vacanAt | aparANi dravyANyAha - catuShpalaM tvagAkShIryA ityAdi | tvagAkShIrI vAMSI | pippalI prasiddhA sudRuDhe tvaticikkaNe BAjane pAtre SuBe aBagne ma~ggalatvAt | ayaM lehaH kaNTakArI saMj~jaH | aSeShata iti sampUrNAriShTadarSanAdapi AsaMcayAdityarthaH | etenAsya prAmANyaM darSitam || 5-9 ||

pada: atha kAsaSvAsAdau kaNTakAryavalehaH - sa yathA - kaNTakArItulAM nIradroNe paktvA kaShAyakam | pAdaSeShaM gRuhItvA ca tasmiMScUrNAni dApayet || 5 || pRuthakpalani caitani guDUcIcavyacitrakAH | mustaM karkaTaSRu~ggI ca tryUShaNaM dhanvayAsakaH || 6 || BArgI rAsnA SaThI caiva SarkarA palaviMSatiH | pratyekaM ca palAnyaShTau pradadyAdGRutatailayoH || 7 || paktvA lehatvamAnIya SIte madhupalAShTakam | catuShpalaM tvagAkShIryAH pippalInAM catuShpalam || 8 || kShiptvA nidadhyAtsudRuDhe mRuNmaye BAjane SuBe | leho~ayaM hanti hikvArtiSvAsakAsAnaSeShataH || 9 ||

vya_text: dI0 - adhunA cyavanaprASAvalehamAha - pATaletyAdi| pATalA prasiddhA, araNiH agnimanthakaH, kASyaryaH gAmBArI, bilvaM prasiddham, aralukaH syonAkaH, parNyau dve tena SAliparNI pRuShThaparNI ceti, tacca dvayaM `kavarAdvayaSabdavAcyaM, bRuhatyAviti dve bRuhatyau kaNTakArIdvayamitityarthaH | SRu~ggI karkaTAKyA, BUmyAmalI tAmalakI, RuddhI iti dvivacanatvena RuddhivRuddhI grAhye, jIvantI SAkaviSeShaH jIvakarShaBakAviti dvau tena jIvaka RuShaBakaSceti, kAkanA- sikA `kauvADoDIti' loke, vidArI kandaviSeShaH, kAkolyAviti dravyadvayaM tena kAkolI kShIrakAkolI ceti, kama- lamutpalaM tadaBAve padmabIjaM grAhyaM, mede dve medA mahAmedA ca, agaruH kRuShNAgaruH, candanaM SvetaM, sthUlacUrNamiti udUKale musalAdiBiH kuTTitamityartha: | na tu vastragAlituM, pa~jcAmalaSatAni ceti | AmalakaPalAnAM guTikAni pa~jcaSatAni atra gaNanAmAnam | evaM sarvatra palAdimAnABAve yathA vakShyamANavarge agastyaharItakyavalehe ``harItakISataM Badram'' ityAdi | evaM BallAtakaguDe ``BallAtakasahasre dve'' iti | yatra palAdimAnamuktaM tatra tu palAdimAnenaiva vyavahAraH | yathA pUrvoktA bAhuSAlaguDe ``catuShpalaM syAdBallAtam'' iti | pacediti hastaparipATIvyavahArAt, tadyathA aKaNDitAmalakaPalaM karpaTe poTTalIM badhvA kvAthanIyaM tena tAni sugrahANi syu: | aShTAvaSeShitamityatra yadgrahaNaM tadvRundaTippaNakAramatamAlokya kRutam | vRunde tu ``j~jAtvA gatarasaM dravyaM rasaM gRuhNIta gAlitam'' ityasya vyAKyAyAM aShTaBAgAvaSeSheNa dravyANAM gatarasatvaM syAt iti | kecittu grAhyaM pAdAvaSeShitamiti paThanti tatra suSrute vAgBaTe ca pAdaSeShe rase ityevoktam | niShkulIkRutyeti | niShkulamiti kShaumAdiGarShaNAt peShaNAdvA tena asthitvagAdirahitamityarthaH | saptapalaparimitena sarpiShA tadBarjanaM kAryaM cakradattoktaM - ``sitA matsyaNDikABAve dhAtryASca mRuduBarjanaM | caturBAge jale prAyo dravyaM gatarasaM Bavet'' iti | KaNDasya kvAthamiti SIrASabdavAcyaM, KaNDenApi kecidvyavaharanti | kShaudramatra SItIBUte dadyAt cyavanaproktamiti cyavano nAma munistena proktaM kathitam, prASyata iti prASaH cyavanasya prASa iti BAvaH | kShINo dhAtukShayo rasAyanamiti jarAvyAdhinASanaM, naro jIrNavivarjita iti naro~asya sevI puruShaH jIrNavivarjitaH jarArahito BavatItyarthaH | yadvA ajIrNavivarjI Bavati, tadapi rogamUlameva yataH ``prAyeNAhAravaiShamyAdajIrNaM jAyate nRuNAm | tanmUlo rogasaMGAtastadvinASAdvinaSyati'' iti ||10-21||

gU0 - pATalAdikamauShadhaM pratyekam ekaikaM palasaMmAnaM sthUlacUrNitamauShadhaM mahatpAtre bRuhatpAtre ekIkRutya pa~jcAmalakaSatAni droNajalaM kShiptvA pacet | aShTAvaSeShitaM prAhyaM, tatastasmAttAnyAmalakAni niShkulIkRutya nistvacAni vAsasA dRuDhahastena saMmardya saptapalamitaM GRutaM datvA tAni ki~jcidBRuShTAni ardhatulonmitaM KaNDaM ca datvA kvAthaM pacet | lehavatsAdhayitvA punaH imAni cUrNAni dApayet | imAni pippalyAdIni kShaudraM ca ShaTpalaM kShipet | pATalA pANDurA, araNi:, kASmarI gamBArI, bilvaH SrIPalaH, araluH syonAkaH, gokShuraH trikaNDakaH, parNyau SAliparNI mudgaparNI ca, bRuhatyau bRuhallaGukaNThakArIdvayaM, pippalyaH, SRu~ggI karkaTaSRu~ggI, drAkShA gostanI, amRutA guDUcI, aBayA harItakI, balA prasiddhA, BUmyAmalakI prasiddhA, vAsA, RuddhiH, jIvantI, SaThI karcUraH, jIvakarShaBakau aShTavargoktau, mustaM nAgaraM, puShkaramUlaM kAkanAsikA , viShNukrAntA, mudgaparNI, mAShaparNI, vidArIkandaH, punarnavA, kAkolI, kamalaM, medA sUkShmailA, agaru candanam etAni pratyekapalAni kvAthyadravyANi aShTavargavidhAnAmaBAve jAtimelanIyAni | spaShTamanyat | etaccyavana^^RuShiNA proktaM cyavanaprASasaMj~jaM Bavati || 10-21||

pada: atha cyavanaprASaH kShayakShINAdau - pATalA~araNikASmaryabilvAralukagokShurAH | parNyau bRuhatyau pippalyaH SRu~ggI drAkShAmRutABayAH||10|| balA BUmyAmalI vAsA RuddhirjIvantikA SaThI | jIvakarShaBakau mustaM pauShkaraM kAkanAsikA || 11 || mudgaparNI mAShaparNI vidArI ca punarnavA | kAkolyau kamalaM Bede sUkShmailAgarucandanam || 12|| ekaikaM palasaMmAnaM sthUlacUrNitamauShadham | ekIkRutya mahatpAtre pa~jcAmalaSatAni ca || 13 || paceddroNajale kShiptvA grAhyamaShTAvaSeShitam | tatastu tAnyAmalAni niShkulIkRutya vAsasA ||14|| dRuDhahastena saMpIDya kShiptvA tatra tato GRutam| palasaptamitaM tAni kiMcidBRuShTvAlpavahninA || 15 || tatastatra kShipetkvAthaM KaNDaM cArdhatulonmitam | lehavatsAdhayitvA ca cUrNAnImAni dApayet ||16|| pippalI dvipalA deyA tugAkShIrI catuShpalA | pratyekaM ca triSANaM syAttvagelApatrakeSaram || 17 || tatastvekIkRutaM sarvaM kShipetkShaudraM ca ShaTpalam | ityetaccyavanaproktaM cyavanaprASasaMj~jitam || 18 || lehaM vahnibalaM dRuShTvA KAdetkShINo rasAyanam | bAlavRuddhakShatakShINA nArIkShINASca SoShiNaH || 19 || hRudrogiNaH svarakShINA ye narAsteShu yujyate | kAsaM SvAsaM pipAsAM ca vAtAsramuraso graham ||20|| vAtapittaM SukradoShaM mUtradoShaM ca nASayet | medhAM smRutiM strIShu harShaM krAntiM varNaprasannatAm ||21|| asya prayogAdApnoti naro jIrNavivarjitaH |

vya_text: dI0 - atha kUShmANDAvalehavivaraNaM darSayannAha - niShkulIti | niShkulIkRutyeti tva~gmajjAdirahitAni kUShmA- NDaSakalAni saMgRuhyetyarthaH | dviguNaM nIramiti kUShmANDaparimANAt tena kUShmANDaSakalAni tulAparimitAni dvitulAmitaM nIramiti ardhAvaSiShTaM kvAtharUpaM jalam | SUlAgrairiti kAShThamayaSa~gkumuKaiH | bahuSo vyadhediti bahucCidrA- Ni kUShmANDaSakalAni kArayediti BAvaH | uktaM ca - hastapATyAM pUrvaM niShkulIkRutaM tadanu kRutacCidraM paScAt saMsvedya kShaumeNa veShTayitvA pIDayet, Atape manAk saMSoShya piShTvA palaSataM gRuhItvA paktavyaM, tena ki~jcidBarjayitveti kiMcidatra yathApAkaM Barjayet | tathAhi ``muktasarpiShi kUShmANDe pAko gandhena mudrayet'' iti | tajjalamityardhAvaSeShitaM pUvAktaM kvAtham | KaNDAt palaSatamiti SarkarApalaSatam | GRutArdhaM kShaudramAvapediti GRutamAnAdardhaM kShaudraM madhu kShipediti BAvaH | Avapediti grahaNena SItIBUte tasmin paScAt melayedityarthaH | AturaSabda: SoShAdiBiH pratyekamaBisaMbadhyate | bAlavRuddheShu yojayediti saumyatvAt dhAtupoShakatvAcca vRuShyaH SukravRuddhikaraH bRuMhaNo dhAtuvRuddhikaraH balakRudojaso vRuddhikara iti || || 22-28 ||

gU0 - palaSataM niShkulIkRutakUShmANDaKaNDAt dvitulAnIre nikShipya pacet ardhaSiShTaM gRuhyate tAni kUShmANDaKaNDAni dRuDhavAsasA pIDayet | punaH ki~jcidAtape SoShayet | punarbahuSUlAgrairvedhayet | punaH kaTAhe kShiptvA aShTapalaM GRutaM dadyAt | tena GRutena ki~jcit Barjayet pUrvoktaM jalaM kShipet KaNDAtpalaSataM datvA sarvamekatra kArayet | supakve pippalI-SuNThI jIraM jIrakam eShAM pRuthak dvipalaM, dhAnyAkaM, patraja, elA, maricaM, tvak taja eShAM pRuthak palArdhaM GRutArdha catuHpalaM kShaudraM madhu | spaShTamanyat || 22-28 ||

pada: atha kUShmANDAvalehaH - niShkulIkRutya kUShmANDaKaNDAtpalaSataM pacet ||22|| nikShipya dviguNaM nIramardhaSiShTaM ca gRuhyate | tAni kUShmANDaKaNDAni pIDayeddRuDhavAsasA || 23 || Atape SoShayetkiMcicCUlAgrairbahuSo vyadhet | kShiptvA tAmrakaTAhe ca dadyAdaShTapalaM GRutam || 24 || tena kiMcidBarjayitvA pUrvoktaM tajjalaM kShipet | KaNDAtpalaSataM dattvA sarvamekatra pAcayet || 25 || supakve pippalI SuNThI jIrakaM dvipalaM pRuthak | pRuthakpalArdhaM dhAnyAkaM patrailA maricaM tvacam || 26|| cUrNIkRutya kShipettatra GRutArdhaM kShaudramAvapet | KAdedagnibalaM dRuShTvA raktapittI kShayI jvarI ||27 || SoShatRuShNAvamicCardiSvAsakAsakShatAturaH | kUShmANDakAvaleho~ayaM bAlavRuddheShu yujyate || 28 || uraHsandhAnakRudvRuShyo bRuMhaNo balakRunmataH |
atha KaNDasUraNAvalehaH arSoroge - yuktyA kUShmANDaKaNDasya sUraNaM vipacetsudhIH ||29|| arSasAM mUDhavAtAnAM mandAgnInAM ca yujyate |

vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM KaNDasUraNAvalehamAha - yuktyeti | kUShmANDaKaNDasya yuktyA kartavyavidhinA ayamapi sUraNA~avalehaH kartavyaH | sudhIriti grahaNena pUrvoktakUShmANDaKaNDe yaddravyaM yanmAnaM yA kartavyatA tat sakalaM vicArya tenaiva prakAreNa sUraNAvalehaH sAdhyaH | viSeSheNa mUDhavAtAnAM mandAgnInAM ca yujyate || 29 ||

dI0 - athAgastyaharItakyavalehaM darSayannAha - harItakISatamityAdi | harItakISataM harItakIguTikASataM na tu harItakIpalaSataM `saMKyA PalAnAM SataSaH palAnAm' iti vacanAt | Badramiti SreShThaM harItakIPalaSataM tena navAdiguNasahitamityarthaH | tathAhyuktam - `navA snigdhA GanA vRuttA gurvI kShiptA tathA~amBasi | nimajjedyA praSa- statvAdguNakRut sA prakIrtitA' iti | yavAnAmADhakamiti | yavo~annaviSeShaH tasya catuHShaShTipalAni | kecittu `harItakISataM BadrayavAnAm ADhakaM tathA' iti paThanti, tatra BadrayavA indrayavA iti vyAKyAnayanti, etanna pracarati sarveShAM saMpradAyavirodhAt | tasmAddharItakISataM Badramiti pAThaH sAdhuH | daSamUlasya viMSatipalAni pratyekaM dvipalamityarthaH | SeShaM dravyaM prasiddhaM | yavaiH svinnairiti upalakShaNe tRutIyA | yavasvinnatA ca caturBAgAvaSeShe jale eva Bavati tena caturBAgAvaSiShTameva grAhyaM | tantrAntare~apyuktaM - `yavADhakaiH pa~jcaBira~gGriSeShaM kvAthaM nayet' ityAdi | paktvAvalehatvamAnIyeti vyavahArAt | harItakISatasya karpaTe poTTalaM baddhvA kvathanaM paScAdutsvinnaharItakISatasya GRutatailayorBarjanaM taddRuDhArthaM | yathA tantrAntare sarvArthasiddhaharItakyAM harItakIBarjanamuktaM | tadanu kvAthe guDatulAM loDayitvA pAkaH karyavyaH, avataraNasamaye pippalIcUrNaprakShepaH | SItIBUte cApare~ahni madhudAnamiti vRuddhAnAM mataM; sugandhArthaM manAk cAturjAmiti kecit | taduktaM - `pippalIcUrNakuDavaM cAturjAtAvacUrNitam' iti | sarpistailAShTakapalamiti yaduktaM tanmilitvA grAhyaM | `harItakIdvayaM KAdet tena lehena nityaSa' iti | yadyapi guDasya BakShaNamAnaM noktaM tathApi harItakIdvirUpagrahaNena lehasya palamAnaM Bavatyeva yathA tantrAntare BArgIguDe `BakShayedaBayAdekAM lehasyArdhapalaM lihet' iti | tenA~atra harItakIBakShaNavidhAnAdguDapalaM BakShyamiti | anye tu gulmocCede harItikInyAyAdguDaM dvipalamAhuH, etat sarvameva vyAdherbalAbalatvAt pracarati | agastyamunivihitatvenAsya siddhaPalatvamucyate || 30-37 ||

gU0 - harItakISataM Badram uttamaM SataM gaNanayA, yavAnAmADhakaM yavo~annaviSeShaH, daSamUlasya viMSatipalAni pratyekaM dvipalaM SAliparNyAdikaM daSauShadhaM citrakAdIni ca pRutha~gmAtrayA dvipalaM, apAmArgaH, SaThI karcUrakapikacCurvAnarI tasyA bIjaM, Sa~gKapuShpakaM SvetapuShpI, BArgI, gajapippalI cavyaPalaM, tadaBAve cavyaM vA, balA prasiddhA, puShkaramUlaM etAni pa~jcADhake nIre pacet | KinnaiH pakvairyavaiH SRutaM kvAthaM nayet | tasminkvAthe aBayASataM dadyAt pakvaM SuShkaM punaH pacet yadvA paScAdaBayApAkaH paktvA lehatvam AnIya sarpirGRutam aShTapalikaM tilajaM kShaudraM madhu guDaM catuHpalaM pippalIcUrNaM ca kuDavaM | tena lehena siddhena harItakIdvayaM KAdet balApekShayA ekaM vA Adau, kShayAdikaM haret | ayaM agastyamuninA~aBihita agastyAvalehaH || 30-37 ||

pada: atha agastyaharItakyavalehaH - harItakISataM BadraM yavAnAmADhakaM tathA || 30|| palAni daSamUlasya viMSatiM ca niyojayet | citrakaH pippalImUlamapAmArgaH SaThI tathA || 31 || kapikacCuH Sa~gKapuShpI BAr~ggI ca gajapippalI | balA puShkaramUlaM ca pRuthagdvipalamAtrayA || 32 || pacetpa~jcADhake nIre yavaiH svinnai: SRutaM nayet | taccABayASataM dadyAtkvAthe tasminvicakShaNaH || 36 || sarpistailAShTapalakaM kShipedguDatulAM tathA | paktvA lehatvamAnIya siddhe SIte pRuthakpRuthak ||34|| kShaudraM ca pippalIcUrNaM dadyAtkuDavamAtrayA | harItakIdvayaM KAdettena lehena nityaSaH || 35 || ayaM kAsaM jvaraM SvAsaM hikvArSo~arucipInasAn | grahaNIM nASayedeSha valIpalitanASanaH || 36 || balavarNakaraH puMsAmavaleho rasAyanam | vihito~agastyamuninA sarvarogapraNASanaH || 37 ||

vya_text: dI0 - idAnIM kuTajAvalehamAha - kuTajatvagiti | kuTajo vRukShaviSeShaH tasya tvak CallI sA palaSataparimitA grAhyA | pAdaSeShamiti caturthAMSaM kaShAyaM vastrapUtaM kRutvA grAhyaM | kutracidetanna pracarati kintu pAdaSeShamiti pAdasya caturthAMSasya yacCeShaM caturBAgaM tadgrAhyam, etenAShTaBAgAvaSeShaM kathitam; tathAca tantrAntare - `kuTajatvakpalaSataM jaladroNe vipAcayet | aShTaBAgAvaSeShaM tu kaShAyamavatArayet | vastrapUtaM tataH kvAthaM pacellehatvamAgatam' iti | triMSatpalaM guDasyAtreti atra kvAthe guDasya purAtanasya triMSatpalaM datvA punarvipacediti yAvat sAndratvaM Bavati | cUrNArthamaparANi dravyANyAha - rasA~jjanamiti rasA~jjanaM pratItaM tacca dArvIkvAthasamudBavamiti prasiddhiH, mocarasaM SAlmalIveShTakam, indrayavaM tvacamiti indrayavaM kuTajabIjaM, tvak guDatvak | durnAmapraBavAn rogAniti gulmodarapraBRutIn, anupAne prayoktavyamiti AjaM takraM, AjaM payaH, AjaM dadhi, AjaM GRutaM ceti | jalaM pAnIyaM, takrAdInAmaBAvAt etatsakalamanupAnaM yathAsAtmyaM niShevedityarthaH | jIrNe ceti dravye parimite sati pathyaBojI Bavennara iti BAvaH | yataH - `auShadhaSeShe Bukta'mityAdivAkyAnurodhAt || 38-44 ||

gU0 - kuTajaH vRukShaviSeShastasya tvak tulAM palaSataM jalasya droNe vipacet | sAndratvaM GanatvamAgataM dRuShTvA imAni rasA~jjanAdIni pratyekaM palamAnAni kShipet | rasA~jjanaM prasiddhaM, prativiShA ativiShA, bAlakam udIcyaM, lajjAluH lajjAvatI, spaShTamanyat || 38 -44 ||

pada: arSAdau kuTajAvalehaH | kuTajatvaktulAM droNe jalasya vipacetsudhIH | kaShAyaM pAdaSeShaM ca gRuhNIyAdvastragAlitam || 38 || triMSatpalaM guDasyAtra dattvA ca vipacetpunaH| sAndratvamAgataM dRuShTvA cUrNAnImAni dApayet|| 39 || rasA~jjanaM mocarataM trikaTu triPalAM tathA | lajjAluM citrakaM pAThAM bilvamindrayavaM tvacAm ||40|| BallAtakaM prativiShAM viDa~ggAni ca vAlakam | pratyekaM palasaMmAnaM GRutasya kuDavaM tathA || 41 | siddhaSIte tato dadyAnmadhunaH kuDavaM tathA | jayedeSho~avalehastu sarvANyarSAMsi vegata: || 42 || durnAmapraBavAnrogAnatIsAramarocakam | grahaNIM pANDurogaM ca raktapittaM ca kAmalAm ||43|| amlapittaM tathA SothaM kArSyaM caiva pravAhikAm | anupAne prayoktavyamAjaM takraM payo dadhi || 44 | GRutaM jalaM vA jIrNe ca pathyaBojI BavennaraH |
